agentResult.finalText:
Done. Changes to `src/money.js`:

- Added `decimalStringToCents(text)`: validates a decimal string with `/^(-?)(\d+)?(?:\.(\d*))?$/` (optional leading `-`, at least one digit required; rejects `""`, `"."`, `"abc"`, `"1e5"`, `"12,34"`, `"12.3.4"`, etc.), and converts it to cents by working from the digit strings — integer part × 100 plus the first two fraction digits as an integer, plus any extra digits as a small fraction. This avoids the classic float trap where `"12.34" * 100` becomes `1233.9999999999998`, so `formatMoney("12.34")` produces exactly the same integer cents as `formatMoney(1234)` under every `round` mode. Invalid strings return `NaN`.
- In `formatMoney`, a string input is run through that parser before the existing check; since `NaN` fails `Number.isFinite`, invalid strings throw the identical `TypeError` with the same message as before. Non-string inputs are untouched.
- Updated the header comment to document the new string form while leaving all documented behaviours as-is — the sign-before-symbol, `decimals: 0`, `grouping: false`, custom `symbol`, and round modes all flow through the unchanged formatting path (strings become plain numbers before it).

Everything works now as far as I can determine by inspection; per the task setup I didn't run the checks myself — verification runs automatically on finish.
